correctness.rationale: At the displayed rational witness, the quadratic-Veronese matrix has rank \(4\), all first determinant derivatives vanish, and the exact 12-by-12 Hessian has rank \(3\), with a normal 3-by-3 minor equal to \(-576\). Nine explicit independent tangent directions to the five-collinear stratum lie in the Hessian kernel, hence equal the full kernel. Because a nine-dimensional singular component passes through the point and the Jacobian linearization of the singular scheme has tangent dimension nine, the singular locus is smooth there. The Hessian is nondegenerate on a complementary normal slice, so the holomorphic Morse-Bott lemma gives transverse \(A_1\); nonvanishing is open.
